project.purpose: Bind existing local-source acceptance, external Archivematica loopback carrier and independent systemd/Artefactual Fixity consumer into a source-qualified R2.1 decomposition without building a new preservation engine.

nodes.label: BoundedLocalPreservationProfile
nodes.responsibility: Compose an explicitly local archival provider profile, source-boundary acceptance, Storage Service loopback ingress and periodic fixity using existing Archivematica, Artefactual Fixity, systemd and Docker Compose providers, without Ordivon owning a preservation runtime.
nodes.authority: Preservation bounded source profile; provider/systemd retain underlying authority
inputs: Local preservation source boundary, external Archivematica/storage/Fixity profiles, local systemd and Compose carrier configuration, archival consumer objective.
outputs: Locally qualified source carrier and bounded evidence of native provider responsibilities, not a global OAIS or deployed-resilience certificate.
behavioralContract: Source correctness and local carrier selection are distinct from installed Storage Service availability, scheduled execution, actual AIP fixity and consumer acceptance.
Upstream providers retain archive, fixity, format and metadata correctness; Ordivon owns no replacement storage engine or metadata ontology.
acceptance: Preservation Owner verify task and artifact provenance can reconstruct this local source contract from exact Git bytes.
Actual live fixity and independent failure domain must be independently observed and cannot be inferred from plan PASS.
consumerEvidence: meta/next/evidence/data-lifecycle/preservation-r1/acceptance.json (historical external consumer evidence, not live currentness)

nodes.label: PreservationSourceBoundaryAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Require exact declared preservation source paths and external-owner boundaries, and reject escaped new payload or dangerous local carrier mismatch before claiming source acceptance.
nodes.authority: Preservation bounded source profile; provider/systemd retain underlying authority
inputs: SOURCE_BOUNDARY.json and exact tracked Preservation payload files; configured local Compose and systemd source carrier.
outputs: Source-only PASS or explicit nonzero boundary/profile rejection; no provider mutation.
behavioralContract: An unlisted tracked payload, empty inclusion pattern, scope-spanning glob, Creative Library misownership, absent storage-service or world-exposed fixity port must be rejected even under optimized Python.
The gate observes tracked Git file membership and current worktree configuration; it is not a dynamic installed-system proof.
acceptance: mise run preservation:verify executes exact entrypoint plus optimized/normal falsification tests.
The new Owner-local LEGO planning carrier must itself be admitted as an exact tracked SOURCE_BOUNDARY path, not silently exempted from the validator.
mustNotOwn: External Archivematica or Artefactual Fixity semantics

nodes.label: ArchivematicaStorageLoopbackProfile
nodes.responsibility: Bind the existing local Archivematica Storage Service Compose overlay to the exact loopback route required by host-native Artefactual Fixity, while delegating actual AIP storage/replication semantics to Archivematica.
nodes.authority: Preservation bounded source profile; provider/systemd retain underlying authority
inputs: External Archivematica 1.18 provider Compose services and host fixity STORAGE_SERVICE_URL consumer at 127.0.0.1:62081.
outputs: Configured local-only host:container port mapping 127.0.0.1:62081:8000 and local provider carrier declarations.
behavioralContract: Storage Service must exist with exact localhost:62081→8000 mapping; missing route, public 0.0.0.0 exposure and wrong host port are rejected by native source boundary consumer tests.
The existence of the Compose service does not establish it is running or reachable; Windows/WSL deployment and independent replica fault domain remain UNKNOWN.
acceptance: Preservation source verifier plus injected missing, public and wrong-port negative tests PASS.
Historical AIP storage/fixity evidence is provenance for earlier exact environment only.
mustNotOwn: Archivematica internal storage or AIP transformations

nodes.label: ScheduledArtefactualFixityConsumer
nodes.responsibility: Express the independent host-native scheduled Fixity consumer under systemd, with external Fixity client and Storage Service URL prerequisites; preserve provider-owned scan results instead of inventing local fixity truth.
nodes.authority: Preservation bounded source profile; provider/systemd retain underlying authority
inputs: systemd service and timer units, external Artefactual Fixity pinned binary, secret-file reference, configured Storage Service route and schedule.
outputs: Source-declared weekly timer trigger and host-native fixity scanall invocation; provider-specific result observed only by external Fixity/Storage Service.
behavioralContract: The service uses host-native pinned Fixity scanall with systemd timer and local service constraints; it must not be represented as an Ordivon fixity engine.
A syntactically valid timer or local service exit zero is not proof that actual Storage Service was healthy, that all AIPs were scanned, or that replica survives a second failure domain.
acceptance: Source verifier validates service/timer presence and profile sections; historical owner evidence records earlier native scan and restart, but requires new installed receipts for currentness.
mustNotOwn: AIP authenticity or external disaster recovery

edges.label: source boundary gates trusted claims about local Compose carrier
Fixity host consumer requires qualified loopback Storage Service ingress, source-level only

gaps: SOURCE_BOUNDARY, Compose and systemd source evidence are qualified only for exact Git/worktree source. This plan does not prove provider binaries installed, service running, Fixity result fresh, or independent offsite failure domain.

Historical preservation operations-r7 and meta/next acceptance receipts are dated September 2026 and bound to other SourceCuts; they identify consumer intent and prior outcomes, not current production acceptance.

AIP contents, PREMIS/METS, OAIS, E-ARK and recovery truth remain external provider/standard owned. Avoid reimplementing Archivematica, Fixity, systemd scheduling or creating a universal Ordivon preservation ledger.
Cross-owner meta/next provenance is a consumer lead; current dynamic consumption and installed/FORMAL proof closedness require separate observations.
doNotOwn: historical evidence as current deployment fact
